en.title: PMS 9.3(1) defines relevant Client Money 'for the purposes of COB 9.1' - COB 9.1 is Trade confirmations
en.summary: PMS 9.3(1): 'For the purposes of COB 9.1. relevant Client Money includes: ...'. COB 9.1 (Reporting to Clients) is 'Trade confirmations'; it does not use the term. The term is used by PMS 9.1(1) ('relevant Client Money in PMS 9.3'), so the intended anchor is PMS 9.1. Meaning survives by context.
en.correction: Please read "For the purposes of PMS 9.1" for "For the purposes of COB 9.1." in PMS 9.3(1) (an editorial correction under section 19(3)(a) of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts).
